## What's Changed

### New Features

- **Search a page's tabs from the command palette**: tabs such as Firewall › Port Forwards or Administration › SSH Access are now searchable; "firewall port" goes straight to Port Forwards.
- **Menu shows up instantly**: the top menu and sidebar are painted from cache on page load instead of appearing after the scripts load.
- **Page content eases in** instead of crossfading the old and new pages over each other.

### Improvements

- The mega-menu opens more smoothly on low-end devices; its full-screen curtain now only dims instead of blurring.

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed the sidebar toggle animation: the content now moves together with the sidebar instead of snapping and sliding back.
- Fixed the search button and the page content shifting while a page loads.
- Fixed the web app manifest icons not loading, and the login card losing its blur on Safari 16.4–17.
- Fixed table cells wrapping when a plugin sets its own table font size, e.g. mini-diskmanager's partition table (#65).
- Fixed table labels being squeezed to one character per line next to long values, e.g. the Dockerman overview (#96).
- Fixed top-level menu entries without children (e.g. iStore) looking different from their neighbours in the sidebar and mobile drawer (#97).

### Other Changes

- For remaining changes, see the [full changelog](https://github.com/eamonxg/luci-theme-aurora/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0)
